notes: Final full-flow binary rebuilt after diagnostic implementation was frozen; initial runs are retained separately, not pooled.
Core benchmark uses both before/after and after/before orders; index benchmark alternates three batches.
Default binaries exclude append-diagnostics. Feature-enabled profiling is a separate diagnostic run, never used for absolute throughput comparison.
Store futures in all 24000 profiled operations returned in one poll. No async wake-to-poll delay does NOT exclude OS blocking/preemption inside synchronous mutex calls.
prepare includes admission/budget/copy; dispatch includes spawn overhead and scheduling; cleanup includes permit/cache/user callbacks; join includes recording and writer flush/resumption.
Core before/after executables were built before adding the optional diagnostics module; their coordinator and benchmark code match final measured logic.
Full-flow baseline binary is prior validated indexed implementation with duplicate invalidation removed; independent later correctness tests do not change the benchmark workload.
No cloud, HTTP or JNI throughput inferred; ranges are observed extrema, not confidence intervals.
